news_summary: Broadcom will report Q3 fiscal 2026 results on Wednesday, Sept 2, 2026, after market close, per its own investor-relations announcement on Aug 3, 2026. That follows a strong Q2 FY2026 print on June 3, 2026 (revenue $22.19B, +48% YoY; AI semiconductor revenue $10.8B, +143% YoY; GAAP diluted EPS $1.91), guidance for Q3 FY2026 revenue of ~$29.4B (+84% YoY) with AI semiconductor revenue expected to exceed $16.0B (+200%+ YoY), and a $0.65/share quarterly dividend -- though the stock sold off after that report on unchanged full-year AI guidance. More recently, on Aug 6, 2026 Broadcom announced new VMware vDefend and Avi Load Balancer security capabilities (native API/AI-app protection, air-gapped deployment support, up to 33% hardware cost reduction), part of its push to diversify beyond AI-chip customer concentration with higher-margin infrastructure software.

catalysts.what: Broadcom will report Q3 fiscal 2026 financial results and business outlook on Wednesday, Sept 2, 2026, after market close, with a 2:00 p.m. PT / 5:00 p.m. ET conference call.

Broadcom reported Q2 FY2026 revenue of $22.19B (+48% YoY) and record AI semiconductor revenue of $10.8B (+143% YoY); GAAP diluted EPS $1.91, non-GAAP diluted EPS $2.44, and a $0.65/share quarterly dividend.
Broadcom guided Q3 FY2026 revenue to approximately $29.4B (+84% YoY) with non-GAAP operating margin of about 67% and Adjusted EBITDA margin of about 68%.

Broadcom announced new VMware vDefend and Avi Load Balancer capabilities -- native API/AI-application protection, air-gapped deployment support, an AI-powered troubleshooting assistant, and up to 33% hardware cost reduction -- for private-cloud multi-layer cyber defense.
Broadcom guided full-year fiscal 2026 AI semiconductor revenue to approximately $56B (+180% YoY) and has separately reiterated a target of exceeding $100B in AI semiconductor revenue for fiscal 2027.

move_thesis: AVGO has been trading on the AI custom-silicon growth story -- Q2 FY2026 AI semiconductor revenue of $10.8B (+143% YoY) and Q3 FY2026 guidance of ~$29.4B total revenue with AI semiconductor revenue expected above $16.0B (+200%+ YoY) -- even though the June 3, 2026 print drew a negative stock reaction on unchanged full-year AI guidance and softer commentary elsewhere in the business. The next catalyst is the confirmed Sept 2, 2026 Q3 fiscal-2026 earnings report, alongside incremental VMware/infrastructure-software announcements (the Aug 6, 2026 vDefend/Avi Load Balancer update) that management is positioning as a higher-margin diversification story against AI-chip customer-concentration risk.
